cases.name: AI Inference Provider
cases.prompt: 请帮我评估一家 AI 推理服务商的交易对手风险。这家公司主要使用 H100 GPU，最近一个月 GPU 使用量约 4200 小时，月收入约 10 万美元，算力支出约 5.8 万美元。历史还款率约 96%，30 天以上逾期率约 2%，目前有 168 个付费客户，前 5 大客户贡献约 36% 的收入。请根据这些信息给出风险评估，如果信息不足，请明确告诉我还缺哪些数据，不要自行编造

cases.name: Limited Evidence
cases.prompt: We are reviewing an AI inference provider. It reports monthly revenue of $40,000. We do not yet have token usage, GPU hours, repayment history, customer concentration or supporting documents. What information is still needed?

cases.name: Risk Signals
cases.prompt: Review a synthetic AI inference provider reporting $60,000 in monthly revenue and $75,000 in compute spend. It reports a 72% repayment rate, 18% of repayments overdue by more than 30 days, 12 paying customers, and 78% of revenue from its top five customers. No supporting documents or operating history have been supplied.
